cave.title: A hidden gem in the Alpine rock
cigar.lead: Adjoining the bar, our Cigar Lounge keeps a very large selection in its walk-in humidor — choose at leisure, then settle in with a dram.
cigar.title: The walk-in humidor
hero.lead: {whiskies} bottlings. Two Guinness World Records. Thirty years of pouring, collecting and telling stories at the edge of Lake St. Moritz.
hero.reserve: Reserve a seat at the bar
meta.description: Devil's Place in St. Moritz — Guinness World Record holder since 1999 for the world's largest whisky selection, with 2,500+ whiskies, a cigar lounge and 1,300+ fine wines in Cave Waldhaus.
meta.title: Devil's Place Whisky Bar & Cave Waldhaus

regions.title: From Islay to the other side of the world
shop.lead: More than a thousand whiskies available to buy directly, including our own bottlings. The shop opens on request — or browse online with our partner World of Whisky.
shop.title: Take a bottle home
story.p1: The church once demonised all distilled water. We took the hint — and named the bar after its most famous critic’s adversary.
story.p2: In 1996 Devil’s Place entered the Guinness Book of Records with 1,000 bottles. By 1999 it had grown past 2,500 — a record it has held ever since. Every year we travel to Scotland to buy casks for our own in-house bottlings, available nowhere else.
story.title: Named for the devil, poured for the angels
